task: A new park allocates 3/4 of its whole land to sports. Half the sports area is courts. Draw the same whole, divide and shade; write 1/2 × 3/4 = 3/8 of the whole and explain why not 1/2.
answer: 3/8 of the entire original park, supported by a 4-by-2 equal-area diagram with three shaded cells
criteria: Shows a complete original park as the whole
Partitions four equal parts, selects three for sports
Halves sports accurately, keeps original whole reference
Explains the diagram and two-step selection
